own.reason: Fix changes moveToCompleted to require lock ownership (else -1) and adds atomic removeOnComplete; findings cover execScript NOSCRIPT-retry args, whenCurrentJobsFinished lost wakeup, and bclient-error loop growth -- different code regions and causes.

Fix defers close() until TimerManager idle (close/disconnect split, timers tracked) to stop close-vs-timer hangs; findings cover pause/resume and reconnect processing-loop multiplication plus priority pass order/budgets -- different mechanisms and regions.

Finding 0 is exact: same shared-'lockRenewer'-timer-name collision across concurrent jobs with the same effect (renewals overwrite/cancel each other), which the fix addresses with per-timer uuid ids. Finding 1 is partial: same TimerManager.set overwrite-without-clearTimeout flaw, but a different effect (orphaned timeout renews a finished job's lock and re-arms). Findings 2 (close vs in-flight delay-timer redis work -- flaw persists post-fix, different mechanism) and 3 (pause/resume loops) do not match.

Fix adds ensureActive to takeLock so a worker cannot lock/process a job no longer in active (double-processing race); findings cover whenCurrentJobsFinished lost wakeup, global-pause bypass, and NOSCRIPT-retry arg loss -- different code and causes.

Fix re-acquires the job lock before moveToCompleted/moveToFailed; finding 0 describes a stale (lock-lost) worker corrupting a finished job (failed-after-completed), same cause (terminal move without holding lock) and effect (corrupt terminal state). Finding 1 is a pause/close wait hang, unrelated. Open 0c611 timer fix matches neither. Concurrency: distributed-lock race.

open.reason: Fix clears the lock-renewal timer before moveToCompleted/moveToFailed+release so an already-released lock is not renewed; finding 2 describes the timer re-arming after finalize, leaking forever and resurrecting the lock, same cause and effect.

own.reason: Fix replaces token locks with redlock distributed locks; no finding describes distributed-lock unsafety. Finding 2 is timer lifecycle (re-arm after finalize), not lock-algorithm correctness; findings 0/1 are run-loop and pause-wait. Opens d42e (stale terminal move) and 0c61 (timer-vs-close) match no finding. Concurrency: distributed locking.
No findings reported, nothing to match. Fix itself stops renewing an already-released lock (timer vs release race). Concurrency: timer-vs-release race.

Fix moves stopTimer() before the closed check in handleCompleted so the lock-renewal timer stops even when closed. Finding 0 is the delayTimer, a different timer/region; findings 1/2/3 are pause/close wait-count and sweeper issues, different mechanism. Concurrency: timer-vs-close race.
